name: Creative Direction
description: Establishes the overall creative direction based on semantic analysis and temporal indexing.

inputs.name: creative_brief
inputs.description: The captain's creative direction as markdown, injected by the runner from the project's creative_brief path. Empty when the project declares none.

inputs.name: project_context
inputs.description: The project's context folder plus the learnings routed to this step, as a MAP the model follows with its shell (never a copy). Injected by the runner from the project's context/ folder and learned_context/ store when this step declares it; a stated absence when the project has neither. See library/tools/project_context.py.

inputs.name: timeline_notes
inputs.description: The captain's own notes typed onto the built timeline in DaVinci Resolve, routed to this step because this step owns the decision each note is about. Injected by the runner from <project>/marker_feedback/ and absent when there are none. See library/tools/marker_routing.py.

inputs.name: prosody_analysis
inputs.description: Per-clip prosody data from step 1.05: pitch contour, speaking rate, voice quality, intensity. Deterministic signal-processing measurements via parselmouth. Projected through view:prosody which filters hollow profiles.

inputs.name: video_preferences
inputs.description: The merged video preferences (style.yaml project layer, video.yaml per-video layer - see library/tools/video_prefs). Injected by the runner when the video declares any; absent otherwise. Read so the direction serves the project's own format, shape and preferences rather than an assumed one.

outputs.name: intent_model
outputs.description: State output: intent_model - the structured intent model beside the prose direction. The narrative as addressable entities: beats (each with a purpose, a setup/payoff link, and a span grounded in the footage), the argument as an ordered set of claims, key moments as entities grounded in a clip and source span, and pacing/energy as a curve over beats. Emitted beside creative_direction, never instead of it. See library/tools/intent_model.py.
